Graduate Admissions
Tips for Getting Started
Admissions to University of Arizona Civil and Architectural Engineering and Mechanics graduate programs are handled through the UA Graduate College. Information provided here is summarized. Please see the Graduate College pages specified below and the CAEM Graduate Student Handbook (PDF) for detailed information.
Apply Now
Interested in a snapshot of the UA CAEM grad programs? Check out this one-page flyer:
Civil and Architectural Engineering and Mechanics Graduate Programs (PDF)
Submission Reminders
Remember to include the following with your application as a decision cannot be entered until all requirements are met and all materials received:
Official transcript, ensuring if you are from India that it includes official sum of total marks and marks obtained for each semester
Minimum GPA requirements for admission:
ME and certificates – 3.0
MS – 3.0 on the last 60 units of undergraduate coursework
PhD – 3.5 during MS study
GRE general test scores – minimum 151 verbal and 155 quantitative – for students seeking a graduate certificate in Advanced Transportation Engineering, ME, MS or PhD
For international students who do not hold degrees from English-speaking universities, TOEFL or IELTS scores dated no more than two years before the term of application
TOEFL Score Reporting and Scoring Change Effective January 21, 2026
The Graduate College website has been updated to reflect changes to the TOEFL scoring and score reporting. The information below summarizes how TOEFL scores will be evaluated under the new structure.
For approximately two years following January 21, 2026, TOEFL score reports will display multiple values, including the CEFR level, the 1-6 section scores, and a comparable score on the legacy scale.
For tests taken prior to January 21, 2026: Minimum score of 79 iBT or Home Edition iBT.
For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: Minimum overall score of 4.0 on the TOEFL 1-6 scale.
Please be mindful of the updated English Speaking Proficiency requirements for Graduate Teaching Assistants (GATs).
TOEFL IBT Speaking Section:
For tests taken prior to January 21, 2026: minimum speaking score of 24
For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: minimum speaking score of 5 on the TOEFL 1-6 scale
Programs may establish higher minimum scores if required by their program. More details and a concordance table can be found here: TOEFL Score Scale Update.
IELTS composite score of at least 7 with no subject area falling below 6
Letter of intent
Three letters of recommendation
Application Codes
GRE Institution Code for the University of Arizona: 4832
Major Field Code for civil engineering: 1102
Major Field Code for civil engineering – other: 1199
Major Field Code for engineering mechanics: 1501
Application Deadlines
Fall: Jan. 1
Spring: June 1
